case_title: Rameshwar and Another v. State of Madhya Pradesh
neutral_facts: The accused, along with five others, approached the victim's house. The accused attacked the victim with an axe, and others caught hold of him. The victim's mother tried to save him and sustained injuries. One of the accused fired a gunshot at the victim, which hit his back, causing fatal injuries. The victim ran out of the courtyard and was later found dead. The post-mortem report indicated a single gunshot wound to the back. The prosecution presented eyewitness accounts, medical evidence, and recovered weapons. The trial court convicted the accused based on the evidence, and the High Court affirmed the conviction.
